name: PDH fade

story.template: {symbol} broke above PDH {line:,.2f} at {break_at}, ran to {run_px:,.2f} ({run_pct:+.1f} %), first 5m close back below at {at}.

note: Stage 2 of the PD fade (design 1 Nov 2026): the first 5m close back below yesterday's high after a run of at least 0.3 % above it, price > 1000. Short at the close, stop = the day's high (the run's extreme), target = the previous close. One per stock per day (cooldown 400 min); min_rr 0 because the fade sits near 1:1 by design. Backtest 20 sessions (1-30 Oct 2026, 213 stocks), all day: 20 fires/day, target first 59 %, median R:R 1:0.9, +0.10 R per trade (before 11:00 only: 12/day, 58 %, 1:0.9, +0.13 R). Round-trip costs take a third to a half of the edge: a candidate list, not twenty trades a day.
